attributes.action: Allow Universal Credit claimants have protected savings pots for essential costs
attributes.additional_details: Universal Credit should allow protected savings for tax, bills, emergencies, car and disability needs, including self-employed costs. We call on the Government to stop penalising responsible budgeting and pushing people into debt. Please sign and share to demand fairer UC savings rules. Fair safeguards can prevent abuse while encouraging budgeting, resilience and work, without forcing claimants to exhaust savings or take on debt.
attributes.background: Change Universal Credit capital rules to allow reasonable protected savings pots for essential costs,including tax, bills,emergencies, car costs and disability needs Claimants should be encouraged to budget and avoid debt, rather than be penalised for responsibly saving for essential future expenses

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action. We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do.

Universal Credit claimants can have up to £6,000 in savings without it affecting their claim. We are not sure how you would like this to change. You can read more about the UC savings thresholds here: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/universal-credit-money-savings-and-investments

You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/777605
